name: How long does an insulation upgrade project usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does an insulation upgrade project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an insulation upgrade project depends on its scope. A simple attic re-insulation for an average-sized home might be completed in one to two days. More extensive projects involving wall cavity insulation, crawl spaces, or spray foam applications can take several days to a week, especially if existing insulation needs to be removed. We strive to complete projects efficiently while ensuring quality workmanship and minimal disruption to your daily routine. We will provide a clear timeline during your initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies: a simple attic can take 1-2 days, while extensive projects involving walls or crawl spaces may take several days to a week.
